description: Place a Harris Teeter Order Ahead order (deli, subs, pizza, platters) for pickup — paid at the store when you collect it. The store starts preparing it and there is no cancel from here, so this sends real work to a person. NOT yet verified against a live order: the first real use is the test. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

time.description: A pickup time from ht_oa_list_pickup_times, e.g. "5:30 PM".

name: ht_oa_place_order
